title: Swan
blurb: Swans are birds of the genus Cygnus within the family Anatidae. The swans' closest relatives include geese and ducks.
facts: Swans are grouped with the closely related geese in the subfamily Anserinae, forming the tribe Cygnini.
Sometimes, they are considered a distinct subfamily, Cygninae.
They are the largest waterfowl and are often among the largest flighted birds in their range.
